# Use the left panel tabs

The **left panel** switches between four tabs. Each tab answers a different question: what can I add, how is the form structured, what are
the form-wide settings, and which saved forms exist.

:::tip Try it

<a href="#" onclick="openMinimalWindow('https://demo.formengine.io/?&formName=event-registration&view=mui'); return false;">Open Event registration in demo</a> - opens the FormEngine demo in a popup window with the form this article starts from.

:::

## Before you begin

- Complete [The Designer workspace](/meet-the-designer/the-designer-workspace) so you know how the left panel fits the screen.

## Components tab

1. Click **Components**.
2. Use **Search...** to filter the list.
3. Drag a component (for example **Text field**) onto the canvas.

<img src="/assets/guide/workspace/highlight-palette.png" alt="Components palette highlighted in the left panel." />

Categories include **Inputs**, **Layout**, **Form**, and **Templates**. Names match the library you chose in **Component library** (for
example Material UI).

## Tree tab

1. Click **Tree**.
2. Use **Expand all** or **Collapse all** for large forms.
3. Click a row (for example under `screen1`) to select that component on the canvas.

The tree shows nested containers and fields. Use it when the canvas is crowded.

<img src="/assets/guide/workspace/tree-panel-plain.png" alt="Tree tab on Event registration with component hierarchy." />

## Settings tab

<img src="/assets/guide/workspace/settings-tab-plain.png" alt="Settings tab with form-wide options." />

1. Click **Settings**.
2. Review blocks such as form **Actions**, **Form validator**, error display, **Tooltip**, **Modal**, and **Language**.

These settings apply to the **entire form**, not the single field selected on the canvas.

## Forms tab

<img src="/assets/guide/manage-forms/forms-tab-plain.png" alt="Forms tab listing saved forms." />

1. Click **Forms**.
2. Add, open, search, or delete saved forms from the list.

Each name in the list is a separate **form**. The Tree root of the open form is the **screen**. Your app shows that form on a **page**;
you do not build that page in Designer.

:::info note

If **Forms** is missing, your app may not expose storage in this environment. Ask your administrator or use menu actions such as
**Download** instead (see [Export and share](/preview-and-handoff/export-and-share-your-form)).

:::

## Check the result

- Switching tabs changes the left content but keeps the canvas visible (except in **Preview**).
- Selecting in the **Tree** highlights the same component as on the canvas.

## Summary

Use **Components** to add fields, **Tree** for structure, **Settings** for the whole form, and **Forms** for the saved-forms list. Search
speeds up large libraries. Whether **Forms** appears depends on storage configuration.
